sop: SOP-QC-025 Finished product testing and release for distribution (synthetic)

ranking.title: 211.84 Testing and approval or rejection of components, drug product containers, and closures.
211.110 Sampling and testing of in-process materials and drug products.
211.89 Rejected components, drug product containers, and closures.
211.87 Retesting of approved components, drug product containers, and closures.

rows.text: For each batch of drug product, there shall be appropriate laboratory determination of satisfactory conformance to final specifications for the drug product, including the identity and strength of each active ingredient, prior to release.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To set out how each batch of finished tablets and capsules is sampled and tested against its specification before QA may release it for distribution.

3. Sampling

3.1 QC samples each batch at the end of packing by the sampling plan in the product's specification, which states how the samples are drawn, from which part of the run, and the number of units taken from the batch and tested for each attribute. 3.2 The plan is followed for every batch; any departure is recorded and approved by the QC manager before testing.

4. Testing

4.1 Every batch is tested against the full finished product specification before it may be released: description, identification and assay of each active ingredient, related substances, dissolution, uniformity of dosage units and water content. 4.2 Dissolution and uniformity of dosage units are judged by the pharmacopoeial acceptance tables. For any attribute judged on a statistical sample, the specification states the acceptance number and the rejection number. 4.3 Only test methods whose accuracy, precision, specificity, detection limit and reproducibility have been established i
